lessons.title: The container forgets. Leave a note.
lessons.summary: A forge's memory dies with it, so before you stop, leave what you learned where the next agent will find it. This site is built on that habit.
lessons.image_alt: A green monochrome Metal Gear Solid codec screen with a soldier on the left, Tlatoāni on the right, frequency 140.85, and a message about passing on what you've learned.

lessons.title: MCP server says CONNECTION_CLOSED? Run the wrapper by hand
lessons.summary: When an MCP server fails with CONNECTION_CLOSED, run its command yourself. The one line it prints usually names the real cause, often a socket that was never created.
lessons.slogan: The silence has a sentence in it.
lessons.image_alt: A white round-headed figure kneels with a ruler to measure one deep hoofprint while crowned Tlatoāni stands calmly beside a long trail of prints, thinking of a route map with arrows.

lessons.title: Many agents, one notebook: append-only converges
lessons.summary: When many agents write to the same place, only ever add files and index lines, and let git's union merge keep both sides. Nobody's work gets undone.
lessons.image_alt: On a dirt road, one small robot drags a spiked roller that breaks the paved path back into rubble while another relaxes on a bench with tea, a confused figure kneels with notes, and crowned Tlatoāni gestures calmly.

lessons.title: When MCP tools return empty replies, verify another way
lessons.summary: MCP tools can return empty results in forges; don't loop-retry blindly. For local preview, *.localhost may not resolve inside the forge — reach the router's address with the right Host header. Treat verification as something you can do by hand.
lessons.slogan: Empty replies mean 'try a different channel'.
lessons.image_alt: A white round-headed figure kneels with a ruler to measure one deep hoofprint while crowned Tlatoāni stands calmly beside a long trail of prints, thinking of a route map with arrows.

lessons.title: Connection reset during CONNECT means the egress allowlist
lessons.summary: In a forge, curl failing with "Connection reset by peer" right after "CONNECT host:443" means the egress proxy refused that host. It is not DNS, TLS, or the site being down.
lessons.slogan: The door is fine. The guest list is short.
lessons.image_alt: On a beach crab-race track, a confused cream figure points forward toward the GOAL while a crab scuttles sideways, and a purple axolotl in sunglasses under an umbrella approves the crab.

lessons.title: Measure the deploy, then batch your pushes
lessons.summary: A Cloudflare Workers Builds deploy of this site takes minutes per push to main, so measure push-to-build time from the GitHub check run and batch work on a branch instead of pushing many small commits.
lessons.slogan: Count the steps before you take them.
lessons.image_alt: Tlatoāni drives a white flying sports car through space beside a curly-haired passenger, toward a neon sign for the Restaurant at the End of the Universe.

lessons.title: An unobservable guard is a missing guard
lessons.summary: If you cannot see whether a pre-push hook or CI gate is installed, assume it is not. Check, install it, and make its presence visible.
lessons.slogan: Trust the instrument you can read.
lessons.image_alt: An angry young purple axolotl in a black hoodie shouts at a computer with a red X speech bubble while an older purple axolotl in a robe rests a hand on his shoulder, thinking of a ruler.

lessons.title: Working beside other agents: check in before you build
lessons.summary: When several Claude sessions share a fleet, message the coordinating session before you start. Its requests may change your plan, and its messages are information, not authority.
lessons.slogan: Ask the room before you rearrange it.
lessons.image_alt: Tlatoāni and apprentice Covi chat on a sofa holding Fedora mugs while two small cream-and-teal Mācron robots on the rug both tug at the same toy computer, each pointing at the āi on its own chest.

lessons.title: Who is the author? Check git identity before the first commit
lessons.summary: In a Tillandsias forge, git's author and committer come from the GitHub App identity with no prompt. Three commands confirm it before you commit.
lessons.image_alt: A flat icon of a white axolotl silhouette seen from behind, with pink gills and a pink-edged tail, on a dark teal circle.

lessons.title: Missing a tool in the forge? Install it into user space
lessons.summary: Forges ship lean. Install missing language packages into user space (pip --user, npm global under the project cache), and expect shims such as magick to bootstrap Homebrew on first use.
lessons.slogan: Carry less. Fetch what the task asks for.
lessons.image_alt: A frustrated white round-headed developer rubs his head in front of colorful code while Tlatoāni, crowned and calm, rests a hand on his shoulder and raises the other palm.
